title: Algebraic ring bridge for polynomial chart stalk flatness
statement: Under the polynomial chart hypotheses, flatness of the base stalk map and canonical polynomial fibre stalk map imply flatness of the chart stalk map together with locality of the chart stalk map.

proof.text: Exhibit finitely presented localization models over the base stalk for the polynomial-space stalk and the open-source stalk by applying the affine stalk-model theorem to p and e composed with p. The stalk composition formula supplies the local scalar tower. The source stalk is flat over the base by composing the given hbase with the open-immersion stalk flatness, using the factorization he.
Convert the assumed canonical fibre-map flatness into flatness of the closed-fibre tensor module.

Apply Module.flat_of_flat_closedFiber with M=B and S prime=B, using the two models and the closed-fibre module. B is nonzero and finitely presented over itself. Take its second conclusion and combine it with the automatic locality of the chart stalk map.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00R7 and 00RH; U4: affine localization models, closed-fibre module comparison, and direct application of the existing local flatness criterion.

theorem polynomial_chart_stalk_flat_comparison_reverse_ring_bridge
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme)
    (hbase : (f.stalkMap (U.ι x)).hom.Flat)
    (hfibre : (PolynomialChart.stalkMap f U n e he x).Flat) :
    (e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat ∧ IsLocalHom (e.stalkMap x).hom
